title: ‘A real gem’ by Mike | South Norwood parkrun
snippet: After the recent warm weather, grey skies and indeed light rain greeted the 225 runners/walkers at Event 416 at South Norwood parkrun. Plenty attended the First timers welcome meticulously delivered by Katy. RD Angela did her brief welcoming everybody and we were soon off. 2 laps in a clockwise direction on trails and paths generally flat, with great support from the marshalls out on the ...

title: South Norwood parkrun, event 415: The one that wasn’t Thames Path (let ...
snippet: We had 47 first-timers at South Norwood today (including me!), with a special mention to Euan LEES, who took the number 1 token. Of those 47, an incredible 7 people completed their very first parkrun—including Oleg VAINAUSKAS, who finished third overall! Well done to all of you, and welcome to your new Saturday morning obsession.
